items.title: SSH servers which use CertChecker as a public key callback without setting IsUserAuthority or IsHostAuthority could be caused to panic by a client presenting a certificate. Cert...
items.summary: SSH servers which use CertChecker as a public key callback without setting IsUserAuthority or IsHostAuthority could be caused to panic by a client presenting a certificate. CertChecker now returns an error instead of panicking when these callbacks are nil.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-39835 是一个影响使用 CertChecker 进行公钥回调的 SSH 服务器的拒绝服务漏洞。CertChecker 是 SSH 库中用于验证客户端证书的组件，它需要设置 IsUserAuthority 或 IsHostAuthority 回调函数来检查证书颁发机构。如果未设置这些回调，当客户端提交一个证书时，CertChecker 会触发 panic（运行时恐慌），导致 SSH 服务器进程崩溃，从而造成拒绝服务。该漏洞的根源在于代码中对 nil 回调缺乏安全处理。修复方式是在 CertChecker 中增加对 nil 回调的检查，当发现回调为空时，不再 panic 而是返回一个明确的错误信息。该漏洞影响所有使用受影响版本 SSH 库且未正确配置回调的服务器。由于 SSH 服务通常用于远程管理，一旦被利用攻击者可以轻易使服务不可用。建议用户立即升级到包含修复的版本，或确保在代码中设置 IsUserAuthority 或 IsHostAuthority 回调。此外，作为临时缓解措施，可以限制对 SSH 服务的网络访问，仅允许可信主机连接，以降低被利用风险。由于缺乏 CVSS 评分和具体受影响产品信息，风险等级暂定为低，但考虑到潜在影响，应尽快修复。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可被未经认证的远程攻击者利用，通过发送特制证书导致 SSH 服务器崩溃，造成服务中断。尽管 CVSS 未评，但影响范围广，需及时打补丁。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可被未经认证的远程攻击者利用，通过发送特制证书导致 SSH 服务器崩溃，造成服务中断。尽管 CVSS 未评，但影响范围广，需及时打补丁。

items.title: When writing data larger than 4GB in a single Write call on an SSH channel, an integer overflow in the internal payload size calculation caused the write loop to spin indefinite...
items.summary: When writing data larger than 4GB in a single Write call on an SSH channel, an integer overflow in the internal payload size calculation caused the write loop to spin indefinitely, sending empty packets without making progress. The size comparison now uses int64 to prevent truncation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于SSH通道的写入操作中。当通过单个Write调用写入大于4GB的数据时，内部负载大小计算存在整数溢出，导致写入循环不断发送空数据包而无法实际传输数据，造成无限循环。漏洞根源在于使用int32类型存储载荷大小，导致溢出后大小被截断为0或较小值。修复方式是将比较和计算改为int64类型，防止截断。目前受影响的具体产品尚未明确。CVSS评分暂未公布。由于该漏洞可能导致服务拒绝或资源耗尽，建议相关SSH实现（如OpenSSH、libssh等）的维护者尽快集成补丁。对于用户，应更新到已修复版本；若无法立即更新，可考虑限制SSH通道的最大写入数据量或监控异常连接。此漏洞未经确认在野利用，但理论上攻击者可构造恶意数据触发。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 整数溢出会导致SSH通道写入无限循环，可能被利用发起拒绝服务攻击，影响大文件传输场景下的稳定性。

items.why_it_matters: 整数溢出会导致SSH通道写入无限循环，可能被利用发起拒绝服务攻击，影响大文件传输场景下的稳定性。

items.title: The in-memory keyring returned by NewKeyring() silently accepted keys with the ConfirmBeforeUse constraint but never enforced it. The key would sign without any confirmation pro...
items.summary: The in-memory keyring returned by NewKeyring() silently accepted keys with the ConfirmBeforeUse constraint but never enforced it. The key would sign without any confirmation prompt, with no indication to the caller that the constraint was not in effect. NewKeyring() now returns an error when unsupported constraints are requested.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-39833 是一个关于 Go 语言中 NewKeyring() 函数的安全漏洞。该漏洞源于 Go 的 in-memory keyring 实现：当用户通过 NewKeyring() 创建一个密钥环时，如果密钥设置了 ConfirmBeforeUse（使用前确认）约束，系统会静默接受该约束，但实际上从未强制执行。这意味着攻击者或恶意程序可以在未收到用户确认提示的情况下，使用这些密钥进行签名操作，且调用者无法察觉约束未生效。这一缺陷违背了安全设计中“显式确认”的原则，可能导致未授权的签名或数据篡改。修复方案是让 NewKeyring() 在检测到不支持的约束时返回错误，从而避免开发者误以为约束生效。目前该漏洞已通过 Go 官方安全更新修复，建议开发者立即升级到包含补丁的 Go 版本。由于该漏洞影响内存中密钥环的安全性，且可能被利用绕过用户确认机制，所有使用 Go 进行密码学操作的应用程序都应评估风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致使用前确认约束被静默忽略，密钥可直接用于签名，可能被恶意利用进行未授权操作，破坏签名完整性。需尽快升级 Go 版本。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞导致使用前确认约束被静默忽略，密钥可直接用于签名，可能被恶意利用进行未授权操作，破坏签名完整性。需尽快升级 Go 版本。

items.title: When adding a key to a remote agent constraint extensions such as restrict-destination-v00@openssh.com were not serialized in the request. Destination restrictions were silently...
items.summary: When adding a key to a remote agent constraint extensions such as restrict-destination-v00@openssh.com were not serialized in the request. Destination restrictions were silently stripped when forwarding keys, allowing unrestricted use of the key on the remote host. The client now serializes all constraint extensions. Additionally, the in-memory keyring returned by NewKeyring() now rejects keys with unsupported constraint extensions instead of silently ignoring them.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 SSH 协议的远程代理密钥转发机制中。当用户使用 ssh-add 向远程代理添加密钥时，约束扩展（如 restrict-destination-v00@openssh.com）未正确序列化到请求中。这意味着，在转发密钥时，目标限制（destination restrictions）被静默移除，导致密钥在远程主机上可以被不受限制地使用。例如，原本限制只能在特定主机使用的密钥，在转发后可用于任意主机，从而扩大了攻击面。攻击者如果能够控制远程代理，或者通过中间人攻击等方式拦截转发过程，就可以滥用该密钥进行未授权访问。此外，内存中的密钥环（keyring）实现也存在问题：由 NewKeyring() 返回的密钥环原本应拒绝带有不受支持的约束扩展的密钥，但实际上却静默忽略这些约束，进一步加剧了风险。最新版本的 OpenSSH 客户端已通过序列化所有约束扩展来修复此问题，并改进了密钥环的验证逻辑。影响版本包括所有未打补丁的 OpenSSH 客户端（具体版本范围未公布，但建议关注厂商公告）。建议用户立即更新 OpenSSH 客户端到最新版本，并在网络层面限制 SSH 代理转发功能的使用，仅在可信环境中启用。该漏洞无需用户交互即可通过正常的密钥转发操作触发，但成功利用需要攻击者能够介入转发链路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞导致 SSH 密钥转发时的目标限制被静默移除，使密钥可被滥用至任意主机，严重破坏访问控制。企业环境中广泛使用 SSH 代理转发，易被横向移动攻击利用。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞导致 SSH 密钥转发时的目标限制被静默移除，使密钥可被滥用至任意主机，严重破坏访问控制。企业环境中广泛使用 SSH 代理转发，易被横向移动攻击利用。

items.title: The Verify() method for FIDO/U2F security key types (sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com, sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com) did not check the User Presence flag. Signatures generated w...
items.summary: The Verify() method for FIDO/U2F security key types (sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com, sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com) did not check the User Presence flag. Signatures generated without physical touch were accepted, allowing unattended use of a hardware security key. To restore the previous behavior, return a "no-touch-required" extension in Permissions.Extensions from PublicKeyCallback.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 OpenSSH 的 FIDO/U2F 安全密钥类型（sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com 和 sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com）的 Verify() 方法中。该方法未检查 User Presence（用户存在）标志，导致无需物理接触硬件密钥即可验证签名。攻击者可以利用此漏洞，在未授权访问密钥的情况下，绕过用户触摸确认，实现未经用户交互的 SSH 认证。这削弱了 U2F 硬件密钥的安全保障——原本要求每次签名都需物理触摸以防止远程或无人值守使用。根据描述，恢复旧有行为需在 PublicKeyCallback 的 Permissions.Extensions 中返回 'no-touch-required' 扩展。受影响的 OpenSSH 版本未明确，但涉及 FIDO/U2F 支持的所有版本均可能受影响。目前无 CVSS 评分和 EPSS 数据，未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV）和报告在野利用。建议用户：1) 尽快关注厂商安全公告，更新 OpenSSH 到修复版本；2) 若无法及时修补，可考虑限制 SSH 密钥的使用环境，例如通过防火墙限制来源 IP、启用额外认证因素；3) 监控异常 SSH 登录活动，尤其是使用 FIDO/U2F 密钥的会话。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者在无需物理接触硬件安全密钥的情况下完成签名验证，破坏了 FIDO/U2F 抗网络钓鱼和二次认证的核心安全机制，可能导致密钥被远程或无人值守滥用，影响 SSH 身份验证的可靠性。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许攻击者在无需物理接触硬件安全密钥的情况下完成签名验证，破坏了 FIDO/U2F 抗网络钓鱼和二次认证的核心安全机制，可能导致密钥被远程或无人值守滥用，影响 SSH 身份验证的可靠性。

items.title: A malicious SSH peer could send unsolicited global request responses to fill an internal buffer, blocking the connection's read loop. The blocked goroutine could not be released...
items.summary: A malicious SSH peer could send unsolicited global request responses to fill an internal buffer, blocking the connection's read loop. The blocked goroutine could not be released by calling Close(), resulting in a resource leak per connection. Unsolicited global responses are now discarded.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于SSH协议实现中，恶意SSH对等体可以发送未经请求的全局请求响应（unsolicited global request responses），这些响应会填充内部缓冲区，从而阻塞连接上的读取循环。被阻塞的goroutine无法通过调用Close()释放，导致每个连接都会产生资源泄漏。攻击者可以利用此漏洞，通过建立多个连接并发送恶意数据包，消耗服务器资源，最终可能导致拒绝服务（DoS）。漏洞触发不需要认证，攻击者只需能够发起SSH连接即可。受影响的软件包括使用特定SSH库（如Go标准库中的crypto/ssh）的应用。厂商已通过丢弃未经请求的全局响应来修复该问题。建议用户及时更新SSH库至修复版本，并限制SSH服务的网络暴露范围，只允许可信来源连接。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞可能导致SSH服务资源泄漏和拒绝服务，影响服务可用性。无需认证即可触发，且修复方法简单（丢弃无效响应），但未修复的服务器可能被攻击者利用。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞可能导致SSH服务资源泄漏和拒绝服务，影响服务可用性。无需认证即可触发，且修复方法简单（丢弃无效响应），但未修复的服务器可能被攻击者利用。

items.title: The RSA and DSA public key parsers did not enforce size limits on key parameters. A crafted public key with an excessively large modulus or DSA parameter could cause several min...
items.summary: The RSA and DSA public key parsers did not enforce size limits on key parameters. A crafted public key with an excessively large modulus or DSA parameter could cause several minutes of CPU consumption during signature verification. This could be triggered by unauthenticated clients during public key authentication. RSA moduli are now limited to 8192 bits, and DSA parameters are validated per FIPS 186-2.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞影响多种实现中 RSA 和 DSA 公钥解析器对参数大小的校验。攻击者可构造包含超大模数或 DSA 参数的公钥，在签名验证阶段导致目标系统 CPU 长时间高负载（可达数分钟），造成拒绝服务。该问题可通过未认证的客户端在公钥认证过程中触发。目前已采取缓解措施：将 RSA 模数上限限制为 8192 比特，并按照 FIPS 186-2 标准验证 DSA 参数。受影响产品范围广泛，包括使用脆弱解析器的 SSH、TLS 及其他依赖公钥认证的组件。建议立即升级至修复版本，并在网络边界限制不可信客户端的公钥认证尝试，以降低暴露风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 无需认证即可远程触发拒绝服务，攻击成本低，影响核心认证流程，可能导致大量服务不可用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可利用特制公钥，在签名验证时消耗目标系统大量 CPU 资源，导致拒绝服务。

items.why_it_matters: 无需认证即可远程触发拒绝服务，攻击成本低，影响核心认证流程，可能导致大量服务不可用。

items.title: When an SSH server authentication callback returned PartialSuccessError with non-nil Permissions, those permissions were silently discarded, potentially dropping certificate res...
items.summary: When an SSH server authentication callback returned PartialSuccessError with non-nil Permissions, those permissions were silently discarded, potentially dropping certificate restrictions such as force-command after a second factor succeeded. Returning non-nil Permissions with PartialSuccessError now results in a connection error.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 此漏洞影响使用SSH服务器认证回调机制时返回PartialSuccessError的情况。在原有的实现中，如果认证回调函数返回PartialSuccessError并且携带非空的Permissions（例如用于证书的限制，如force-command），这些Permissions会被静默丢弃而不报错。这意味着在第二因素认证成功后，原本应施加的证书限制（如强制执行的命令）可能被绕过，导致权限提升或未授权访问。攻击者如果能够利用此漏洞，可能通过精心构造的认证流程绕过服务器端对用户会话的限制。该问题源于代码逻辑中对PartialSuccessError与Permissions组合的处理不完善，导致权限信息丢失。修复方案是当返回非空Permissions与PartialSuccessError时，服务器主动触发连接错误，从而阻止潜在的权限绕过。受影响的产品范围包括使用该SSH实现且依赖证书限制的服务器。建议用户尽快更新至修复版本，或临时限制对SSH服务的网络暴露以减少风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 此漏洞可导致SSH证书中的强制命令等限制被静默绕过，允许用户在第二因素认证后获得超出预期的权限，构成中等严重性安全风险。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 优先更新SSH服务器软件至包含修复的版本；若无法立即更新，可限制SSH服务的来源IP访问或启用额外日志监控可疑认证行为。

items.why_it_matters: 此漏洞可导致SSH证书中的强制命令等限制被静默绕过，允许用户在第二因素认证后获得超出预期的权限，构成中等严重性安全风险。

items.title: An authenticated SSH client that repeatedly opened channels which were rejected by the server caused unbounded memory growth, eventually crashing the server process and affectin...
items.summary: An authenticated SSH client that repeatedly opened channels which were rejected by the server caused unbounded memory growth, eventually crashing the server process and affecting all connected users. Rejected channels are now properly removed from the connection's internal state and released for garbage collection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-39827 是一个存在于 SSH 服务器中的拒绝服务漏洞。当已认证的 SSH 客户端反复打开通道，而服务器拒绝这些通道时，服务器未能正确清理相关内部状态，导致无界的内存增长。随着时间推移，内存耗尽将使服务器进程崩溃，影响所有当前连接的客户端，造成服务中断。漏洞触发条件简单，仅需一个有效的认证客户端即可实施，无需特殊权限或复杂操作。官方修复方案是确保被拒绝的通道能够从连接的内部状态中正确移除，并触发垃圾回收释放内存。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也无在野利用报告，但考虑到 SSH 的广泛使用，建议受影响用户尽快更新至包含修复的版本或应用补丁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 已认证的SSH客户端即可触发拒绝服务，影响服务器可用性；SSH服务常用于远程管理，一旦崩溃可能导致运维中断。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者通过认证的SSH客户端重复打开被拒绝的通道，导致服务器内存无界增长，最终崩溃，造成拒绝服务。

items.why_it_matters: 已认证的SSH客户端即可触发拒绝服务，影响服务器可用性；SSH服务常用于远程管理，一旦崩溃可能导致运维中断。

items.title: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SketchUp 2026's Dynamic Components feature allows remote code execution and local file exfiltration through maliciously crafted SKP...
items.summary: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SketchUp 2026's Dynamic Components feature allows remote code execution and local file exfiltration through maliciously crafted SKP files. The vulnerability stems from improper input sanitization in the component options window, enabling attackers to execute arbitrary system commands and read local files without user interaction by exploiting an embedded Internet Explorer 11 browser.

llm_summary.summary_zh: SketchUp 2026 的 Dynamic Components（动态组件）功能中存在一个跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞。该漏洞源于组件选项窗口对用户输入的不当清理，攻击者可以通过构造恶意的 SKP 文件触发漏洞。由于 SketchUp 在渲染动态组件时嵌入了 Internet Explorer 11 浏览器控件，该 XSS 漏洞可被利用实现远程代码执行（RCE）和本地文件窃取。攻击者无需用户交互，只需目标打开恶意 SKP 文件即可触发。目前已确认该漏洞影响 SketchUp 2026 版本，但厂商尚未发布官方补丁。建议用户谨慎处理来源不明的 SKP 文件，并在补丁可用后立即更新。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下通过恶意 SKP 文件实现远程代码执行和文件窃取，危害极高，可能影响大量使用 SketchUp 的设计行业用户。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用该漏洞在受害者系统上执行任意命令，并读取本地敏感文件，造成数据泄露和系统完全受控。

items.summary: A malicious actor with access to the network and low privileges could exploit a Path Traversal vulnerability found in UniFi OS devices to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to obtain sensitive information.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-34911 是影响 Ubiquiti UniFi OS 设备的一个路径遍历漏洞。具有网络访问权限的低权限攻击者可以利用该漏洞，通过构造特殊路径请求，访问底层文件系统中本应受限的文件。漏洞源于对用户输入路径的过滤不足，允许使用 '..' 等序列进行目录回溯。攻击成功后，攻击者可以读取任意文件，包括配置文件、日志、数据库文件等，从而获取敏感信息如管理员凭据、网络拓扑、加密密钥等。该漏洞的 CVSS v3.1 评分为 7.7，属于高危漏洞，攻击向量为网络（AV:N），攻击复杂度低（AC:L），需要低权限（PR:L），无需用户交互（UI:N），且影响范围发生变化（S:C），机密性影响为高（C:H），但完整性和可用性不受影响。目前该漏洞尚未被列入已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV），也没有在野利用的公开报告。建议用户立即关注 Ubiquiti 官方安全公告，并尽快将 UniFi OS 升级到包含修复的版本。同时，应限制 UniFi 设备的管理接口仅对受信任网络暴露，减少攻击面。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限远程攻击者读取 UniFi OS 设备上的任意文件，可能导致敏感信息泄露，如管理员凭证和网络配置，对网络基础设施造成严重威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用路径遍历读取系统文件，获取敏感信息，包括配置、凭据、密钥等，直接影响保密性。

items.title: A Large Language Model Approach to Generating Bypass Rules for Malware Evasion in Analysis Sandbox
items.summary: Sandbox evasion remains a critical challenge for automated malware analysis, as modern malware employs environment checks to detect analysis platforms and suppress malicious behavior. Existing approaches rely on manually crafted bypass rules that require deep reverse engineering of each evasion mechanism -an approach that cannot scale against rapidly evolving evasion techniques. In this paper, we leverage large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate YARA rules that bypass evasion checks in sandbox environments. We propose ABLE, which analyzes execution traces from malware terminated due to potentially evasive behavior and employs multiple reasoning strategies to generate targeted bypass rules. To address syntactic errors and improve the efficacy of the bypass rules in the LLM outputs, we introduce an auto-sanitization pipeline and feedback-driven iterative refinement. We evaluate ABLE on 334 real-world malware samples across four open-weight LLMs. ABLE achieves a 79% bypass success rate, with iterative refinement contributing 29.5% of successful cases. Compared to existing analysis platforms, ABLE identifies 47% more malware family classifications and exposes previously hidden behaviors.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对沙箱逃逸这一自动化恶意软件分析中的关键挑战，提出了一种利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成YARA规则以绕过沙箱环境检测的方法。现有方法依赖人工逆向工程每个逃逸机制来编写绕过规则，难以应对快速演变的逃逸技术。作者提出的ABLE系统通过分析因潜在逃逸行为而终止的恶意软件执行轨迹，采用多种推理策略（如直接生成、错误反馈迭代等）来生成针对性的绕过规则。为了解决LLM输出中的语法错误并提高规则有效性，引入了自动净化管道和反馈驱动的迭代优化。在334个真实恶意软件样本上对四个开源LLM进行了评估，ABLE实现了79%的绕过成功率，其中迭代优化贡献了29.5%的成功案例。与现有分析平台相比，ABLE识别的恶意软件家族分类数量提高了47%，并揭示了先前隐藏的行为。本文主要贡献在于：1）首次将LLM应用于沙箱逃逸规则的自动生成；2）提出一种结合执行轨迹分析和迭代优化的框架；3）通过实验证明了该方法在提升恶意软件分析深度和广度方面的有效性。适合安全分析师、恶意软件研究人员以及致力于自动化安全工具开发的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了LLM在自动化对抗沙箱逃逸方面的巨大潜力，可帮助安全团队更高效地发现和分析隐藏的恶意行为，提升威胁检测能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对沙箱厂商和恶意软件分析平台有直接影响，可集成至现有分析管线以提升暴露隐蔽行为的效率；方法也可迁移至其他需要绕过规则自动生成的场景。

items.title: Adversarial Reframing: A Framework for Targeted Generation in Language Models
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely deployed in diverse real-world settings, yet remain vulnerable to jailbreaking, where prompt-based attacks bypass safety filters. We present THREAT (Targeted Harmful generation via Reframing and Exploitation of Adversarial Tactics), a reasoning-driven framework that coordinates multiple LLMs in an iterative search loop to find textual jailbreak prompts. We formulate prompt discovery as a nonconvex optimization problem and provide an efficient solution that lowers runtime and improves attack effectiveness. Across diverse datasets and model architectures, THREAT delivers higher attack success rates with lower computational cost than prior methods. The crafted prompts were flagged as harmful in fewer than 1% of cases, compared with about 50% refusals for the corresponding unmodified prompts. These findings reveal previously undetected vulnerabilities in aligned LLMs and position THREAT as a practical tool for proactively strengthening the safety of foundation models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在现实世界中广泛部署，但容易受到越狱攻击——通过基于提示的操纵绕过安全过滤器。本文提出THREAT（通过重构和利用对抗策略进行定向有害生成）框架，一种推理驱动的攻击方法，协调多个LLM在迭代搜索循环中自动发现文本越狱提示。作者将提示发现形式化为非凸优化问题，并提供高效解法，降低运行时并提升攻击效果。在多个数据集和模型架构上，THREAT相比先前方法实现了更高的攻击成功率和更低的计算成本。生成的越狱提示中被标记为有害的比例低于1%，而对应未修改的提示约有50%被拒绝。这些发现揭示了对齐LLM中先前未被检测到的漏洞，并使THREAT成为主动增强基础模型安全性的实用工具。该论文适合LLM安全研究人员、红队工程师以及AI安全策略制定者阅读。

items.title: A First Measurement Study on Authentication Security in Real-World Remote MCP Servers
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is emerging as a common interface connecting large language models (LLMs) with external services. Remote deployments are becoming increasingly important as agents connect to user-linked online services, such as social, productivity, and financial services. In such deployments, the authentication boundary between MCP clients and remote servers becomes security-critical, yet remains underexplored. We present the first measurement study of authentication security in real-world remote MCP servers. We identify 7,973 live remote MCP servers, finding that 40.55% expose tools without authentication. Among authenticated servers, OAuth is the dominant authorization mechanism for reaching remote services, and OAuth deployments in the MCP ecosystem commonly exhibit three characteristics: open client environments, dynamic client registration, and delegated authorization. These characteristics distinguish MCP deployments from traditional OAuth and introduce new attack surfaces. Guided by this observation, we derive a taxonomy of authentication flaws comprising three MCP-specific categories and conventional OAuth misconfigurations, for a total of four categories and nine concrete flaw types. To evaluate these flaws at scale, we implement a semi-automated detection framework that combines passive traffic inspection with active dynamic probing. Applying it to 119 testable real-world OAuth-enabled MCP servers, we find that each server exhibits at least one flaw, with a total of 325 flaws identified, among which dynamic client registration flaws affect 96.6% of tested servers. Many of these flaws can lead to sensitive information leakage and account takeover. Through responsible disclosure, we obtained 9 CVE IDs. Our findings expose pervasive authentication weaknesses in the MCP ecosystem and underscore the urgent need for hardened OAuth-based remote deployments.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次对真实世界中远程模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器的认证安全状况进行了大规模测量研究。MCP正成为连接大型语言模型（LLM）与外部服务的通用接口，特别是在远程部署场景下，MCP客户端需要访问用户关联的在线服务（如社交、生产力、金融服务），此时客户端与远程服务器之间的认证边界变得至关重要，但此前未被充分探索。研究者首先发现了7,973个在线远程MCP服务器，其中40.55%的工具暴露无需任何认证。在已实施认证的服务器中，OAuth是远程服务授权的主要机制，但MCP生态中的OAuth部署普遍存在三个特征：开放的客户端环境、动态客户端注册和委托授权。这些特征将MCP部署与传统OAuth场景区分开来，并引入了新的攻击面。基于此，研究者归纳出一个认证缺陷分类法，包含三类MSP特有缺陷以及传统OAuth配置错误，共四个类别、九种具体缺陷类型。为了大规模评估这些缺陷，研究者实现了一个半自动化检测框架，结合被动流量检查和主动动态探测。将该框架应用于119个可测试的真实OAuth启用的MCP服务器，发现每个服务器至少存在一个缺陷，总共识别出325个缺陷，其中动态客户端注册缺陷影响了96.6%的测试服务器。许多缺陷可导致敏感信息泄露和帐户接管。通过负责任披露，研究者获得了9个CVE编号。研究结果揭示了MCP生态系统中普遍存在的认证弱点，并强调了在基于OAuth的远程部署中加强安全性的紧迫性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MCP协议是LLM与外部服务交互的关键接口，本研究首次系统揭示了其远程服务器普遍存在认证缺陷，可能导致敏感数据泄露和账户劫持，对采用MCP的AI应用安全性构成直接威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有部署了远程MCP服务器的LLM应用，尤其是涉及用户在线服务的场景；发现的缺陷可被用于未授权访问用户数据、执行恶意操作，甚至接管账户。
detection_signals_zh: MCP服务器工具暴露时未要求认证
OAuth动态客户端注册未加严格限制
OAuth授权流程中的委托权限过宽
客户端环境开放导致凭证泄露风险
defense_advice_zh: 对MCP服务器实施强制认证，避免工具匿名暴露
在OAuth部署中加固动态客户端注册流程，限制客户端数量和作用域
实施最小权限原则，MCP客户端仅请求必要权限
部署定期自动化安全扫描，检测已知认证缺陷类型
遵循OAuth最佳实践，如使用PKCE、限制回调URI

items.title: Finding Missing Input Validation in TEEs via LLM-Assisted Symbolic Execution
items.summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation that protects sensitive code and data from untrusted software. Despite their strong security guarantees, analyzing TEE applications remains challenging due to the high cost and complexity of configuring complete TEE build and runtime environments, as well as the limited observability imposed by hardware isolation. This paper presents SymTEE, a novel large language model (LLM)-assisted symbolic execution framework for detecting missing input validation issues in TEE applications without requiring real TEE setups. SymTEE begins by leveraging Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analysis to extract TEE code slices that may lack sufficient input validation, and then employs an LLM (GPT-5 in our case) to automatically convert the extracted slices into KLEE-compatible harness programs containing lightweight mock execution environments for symbolic analysis. Evaluations on 26 vulnerabilities (11 real-world and 15 synthetic) show that SymTEE achieves 100% precision and 92.3% recall in detecting missing input validation vulnerabilities while incurring an average analysis cost of only $0.05. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of SymTEE's pioneering paradigm of LLM-assisted symbolic execution, where LLMs autonomously generate mock environments to enable automated security analysis without complex setup, providing a more accessible and scalable framework for trusted computing systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 SymTEE，一种新颖的 LLM 辅助符号执行框架，专门用于检测可信执行环境（TEE）应用中的输入验证缺失漏洞，而无需搭建真实的 TEE 环境。TEE 通过硬件强制隔离保护敏感代码和数据，但配置完整的 TEE 构建和运行环境成本高昂、复杂，且硬件隔离限制了可观测性，导致应用安全分析困难。SymTEE 首先利用抽象语法树（AST）分析提取可能缺乏充分输入验证的 TEE 代码切片，然后使用大型语言模型（LLM，本文采用 GPT-5）自动将提取的切片转换为 KLEE 兼容的驱动（harness）程序，其中包含轻量级的模拟执行环境，以便进行符号分析。在 26 个漏洞（11 个真实世界漏洞和 15 个合成漏洞）上的评估显示，SymTEE 在检测输入验证缺失漏洞方面实现了 100% 的精确率和 92.3% 的召回率，平均分析成本仅为 0.05 美元。实验结果证明了 SymTEE 这一开创性范式的有效性和实用性，即 LLM 自主生成模拟环境，无需复杂设置即可实现自动化安全分析，为可信计算系统提供了更易用、可扩展的框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: TEE 应用安全分析长期面临环境配置复杂、可观测性差等问题，SymTEE 首次将 LLM 与符号执行结合，无需真实硬件即可高效检测输入验证缺失漏洞，显著降低了分析门槛和成本。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 TEE 应用的安全性检测，可迁移至其他隔离执行环境（如机密计算、安全飞地）的漏洞挖掘场景。

items.title: Parser-Free Querying of Security Logs
items.summary: Security analysts routinely query system logs to detect threats and investigate incidents, but each log source uses its own semi-structured format: logs are cheap to produce, but expensive to use. The standard approach, building per-source parsers to normalize logs into structured schemas, is powerful but requires continuous engineering effort for each new format. Querying raw logs directly with tools like grep avoids this cost, but requires analysts to know each source's message variants and cannot express the multi-line temporal queries that security investigations demand. We present Sieve, a system that generates executable query code from natural-language security questions by grounding a large language model with lightweight, automatically extracted log-format context, requiring only one LLM call per query followed by deterministic execution. Evaluating 133 security queries across 5 log types, we find that Sieve achieves over a 3x reduction in error rate on complex temporal and cross-event queries compared to manual analyst scripting, with the largest gains on the multi-line correlation tasks most critical to active investigations. Our results and benchmark provide evidence that LLM-generated code can bridge the gap between the expressiveness of structured log querying and the immediacy of working directly with raw files.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了名为Sieve的系统，旨在解决安全分析师在查询系统日志时面临的困境：现有日志来源采用多种半结构化格式，传统方法需要对每种格式构建解析器以标准化为结构化模式，虽功能强大但工程开销大；而直接使用grep等工具查询原始日志虽避免了解析成本，但无法表达复杂的时间序列跨事件查询。Sieve利用大型语言模型（LLM），通过自动提取的轻量级日志格式上下文，从自然语言的安全问题生成可执行的查询代码，每个查询仅需一次LLM调用后执行确定性代码。研究者在5种日志类型上评估了133个安全查询，结果显示，与人工分析师脚本相比，Sieve在复杂时间序列和跨事件查询上的错误率降低了3倍多，尤其是在多行关联任务（对积极调查至关重要）上提升最大。论文提供了基准测试，证明LLM生成的代码能够弥合结构化日志查询的表达能力与直接操作原始文件的即时性之间的差距。适合安全分析师、日志管理工具开发者及LLM应用研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接回应了安全日志分析中解析成本高与查询表达力不足的核心矛盾，提供了一种低门槛、高准确率的自动化查询方案，有望降低安全团队的手动工作负担并加速事件响应。

items.title: FuzzingBrain V2: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Vulnerability Discovery and Reproduction
items.summary: Software vulnerabilities pose critical security threats, with nearly 50,000 CVEs reported in 2025. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for automated vulnerability detection, three key challenges remain. First, LLM-generated vulnerability reports suffer from high false positive rates and lack reproducible verification. Second, existing LLM-based approaches use suboptimal granularities for vulnerability localization: function-level analysis overlooks bugs when context becomes extensive, while line-level analysis lacks sufficient context. Third, existing approaches have difficulty reasoning about vulnerabilities with complex cross-function dependencies and triggering conditions. We present FuzzingBrain V2, a multi-agent system that addresses these gaps through four key contributions: (1) fully automated vulnerability analysis built on Google's OSS-Fuzz, ensuring all reported vulnerabilities are fuzzer-reproducible; (2) Suspicious Point, a novel control-flow-based abstraction for precise vulnerability localization at the optimal granularity; (3) logic-driven hierarchical function analysis with dual-layer fuzzing enhancing function coverage under resource constraints; (4) MCP-based static and dynamic analysis tools with context engineering enhancing complex vulnerability reasoning. On the AIxCC 2025 Final Competition C/C++ dataset, FuzzingBrain V2 achieved 90% detection rate (36 of 40 vulnerabilities). In real-world deployment, FuzzingBrain V2 discovered 29 zero-day vulnerabilities across 12 open-source projects, all confirmed and fixed by maintainers, with 2 assigned CVE IDs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 软件漏洞是严重的安全威胁，仅2025年就报告了近5万个CVE。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化漏洞检测方面展现出潜力，但仍面临三大挑战：一是LLM生成的漏洞报告误报率高且缺乏可复现验证；二是现有基于LLM的方法在漏洞定位中使用次优粒度，函数级分析在上下文过大时忽略错误，而行级分析缺乏足够上下文；三是现有方法难以推理具有复杂跨函数依赖和触发条件的漏洞。本文提出FuzzingBrain V2，一个多智能体系统，通过四项关键贡献解决上述问题：（1）基于Google OSS-Fuzz的全自动漏洞分析，确保所有报告的漏洞均可通过模糊测试复现；（2）提出Suspicious Point，一种新颖的基于控制流的抽象，实现最佳粒度的精确漏洞定位；（3）逻辑驱动的层次函数分析，结合双层模糊测试，在资源约束下提高函数覆盖；（4）基于MCP的静态和动态分析工具，结合上下文工程，增强复杂漏洞推理能力。在AIxCC 2025决赛C/C++数据集上，FuzzingBrain V2实现了90%的检测率（40个漏洞中检测出36个）。在真实世界部署中，FuzzingBrain V2在12个开源项目中发现了29个零日漏洞，全部由维护者确认和修复，其中2个已分配CVE编号。该研究适合安全研究人员、漏洞挖掘工程师以及关注自动化漏洞检测技术的从业者阅读。

items.title: HIDBench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Host-Based Intrusion Detection
items.summary: Recent benchmark efforts have advanced the evaluation of large language models (LLMs) in cybersecurity, including tasks such as penetration testing and vulnerability identification. However, a critical cybersecurity task, namely intrusion detection from system logs, remains unexplored. In this work, we present a new benchmark to assess LLMs' capabilities in supporting host-based intrusion detection systems (HIDS). This task requires fine-grained reasoning over large-scale, noisy, and highly imbalanced system logs, where complex interactions between benign and malicious activities make reliable detection challenging. Our benchmark unifies three public system log datasets, DARPA-E3, DARPA-E5, and NodLink, and introduces a data construction pipeline that transforms raw host telemetry into LLM-compatible inputs, enabling systematic evaluation under realistic intrusion detection settings. Our evaluation of frontier LLMs reveals substantial performance gaps across datasets. While many models achieve high precision (often above 0.8) on simpler datasets, their performance degrades significantly as system logs become noisier and more complex, with MCC frequently dropping below 0.5 and false positive rates increasing sharply. We further analyze model behavior and identify distinct regimes, including conservative detectors with low false positive rates and over-sensitive models that generate excessive alerts. Overall, our results highlight that while LLMs show strong potential for HIDS, their effectiveness is highly sensitive to data complexity, and robust system design is essential for reliable deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一个新的基准测试 HIDBench，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在基于主机的入侵检测系统（HIDS）中的能力。现有的 LLM 安全基准主要关注渗透测试、漏洞识别等任务，但忽略了从系统日志进行入侵检测这一关键任务。入侵检测需要在大规模、高噪声、极度不平衡的系统日志上进行细粒度推理，良性活动与恶意活动之间的复杂交互使得可靠检测极具挑战。HIDBench 统一了三个公开的系统日志数据集：DARPA-E3、DARPA-E5 和 NodLink，并设计了一个数据构建流水线，将原始主机遥测数据转换为 LLM 兼容的输入格式，从而能够在现实入侵检测设置下进行系统评估。作者评估了多个前沿 LLM，发现在不同数据集上存在显著的性能差距。许多模型在较简单的数据集上实现了较高的精确率（通常高于 0.8），但随着系统日志噪声和复杂度的增加，性能急剧下降，马修斯相关系数（MCC）经常低于 0.5，假阳性率急剧上升。进一步分析模型行为，发现了不同的模式，包括低假阳性率的保守检测器和过度敏感的模型（产生过多的警报）。总体而言，实验结果表明，虽然 LLM 在 HIDS 中展现出强大的潜力，但其有效性对数据复杂度高度敏感，稳健的系统设计对于可靠部署至关重要。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统评估 LLM 在主机入侵检测这一关键任务上的表现，填补了现有 LLM 安全基准的空白，对理解 LLM 在安全运营中的适用边界和局限性具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该基准可直接用于衡量和比较不同 LLM 在入侵检测场景下的能力，未来可迁移到其他日志分析任务（如异常检测、事件响应）或集成到实际 HIDS 产品中。

items.title: PocketAgents: A Manifest-Driven Library of Autonomous Defense Agents
items.summary: Connecting large language models (LLMs) to defensive enforcement requires more than asking a model whether an attack is happening. A defender must decide which model outputs may change the system state, which outputs must be rejected, and how failures should be recorded. We present PocketAgents, a manifest-driven library of autonomous defense agents. Each agent is installed as three data files: a manifest, a prompt, and a runtime context. The shared runtime gives the agent bounded telemetry access and accepts only typed reports whose requested action appears in the manifest. We implemented PocketAgents on top of a cyber arena (Perry), a cyber-deception testbed, and evaluated two agents, Command and Control and Exfiltration, in 18 closed-loop trials of a DarkSide-inspired attack on a small enterprise topology. Thirteen trials produced validated network-block actions and contained the attack; four failed schema validation; one produced a valid no-action decision. The experiments show that a typed boundary makes LLM-driven defense measurable, extensible, and attributable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 PocketAgents，一个基于清单驱动（manifest-driven）的自主防御智能体库，旨在解决将大语言模型（LLM）应用于防御执行时面临的挑战。传统上，仅询问模型是否正在发生攻击不足以实现有效防御，防御者需要决定哪些模型输出可以改变系统状态、哪些必须被拒绝，以及如何记录失败。PocketAgents 中的每个智能体以三个数据文件形式安装：清单（manifest）、提示词（prompt）和运行时上下文（runtime context）。共享运行时为智能体提供有限的遥测访问权限，并仅接受清单中声明了请求动作的类型化报告。作者在网络安全竞技场 Perry（一个网络欺骗测试平台）上实现了 PocketAgents，并针对两个智能体——命令与控制（Command and Control）以及数据泄露（Exfiltration）——在 18 次闭环试验中评估了其效果。试验模拟了受 DarkSide 启发的小型企业拓扑攻击。结果显示：13 次试验产生了经过验证的网络阻断动作并遏制了攻击；4 次试验因模式验证失败；1 次试验产生了有效的无动作决策。实验表明，类型化边界使 LLM 驱动的防御变得可度量、可扩展且可归因。

items.title: ASSEMBLAGE-DEEPHISTORY: A Cross-Build Binary Dataset with Temporal Coverage
items.summary: Existing binary corpora typically capture only one or two axes of binary variation: they either provide cross-compiler builds without a temporal axis, or CVE labels for single-build binaries. None combine cross-build diversity, cross-version history, and CVE labels into a queryable structure. We present ASSEMBLAGE-DEEPHISTORY, which consolidates these dimensions into a unified framework where every binary's compilation context, source code, vulnerable functions, and package version are stored as first-class metadata. ASSEMBLAGE-DEEPHISTORY comprises 73,610 binaries spanning 248 open-source projects, compiled across GCC, Clang, and MSVC at multiple optimization levels on Linux and Windows, with multi-year historical builds. Each binary is indexed in a database that links it to its source code, functions, debug info, variant builds, historical versions, and vulnerable functions. Three analyses demonstrate this structure's value: (1) a three-stage LLM benchmark (recognition, strategy-guided detection, and cross-build transfer) to test whether LLMs reason about binary vulnerabilities or pattern-match on build-specific artifacts; (2) a comparison of MalConv embeddings, jTrans function embeddings, and TLSH fuzzy hashes quantifying how same-package versions cluster in each space; and (3) a Bayesian regression decomposing binary similarity into contributions from temporal distance, file changes, and commits.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为ASSEMBLAGE-DEEPHISTORY的跨构建二进制数据集，旨在解决现有二进制语料库在维度覆盖上的不足。现有数据集通常只涵盖编译多样性（如跨编译器构建）或时间轴（如历史版本），或仅包含单一构建的CVE标签，但缺乏将跨构建多样性、跨版本历史以及CVE标签整合到统一可查询结构中的能力。ASSEMBLAGE-DEEPHISTORY将这些维度合并为一个统一框架，其中每个二进制文件的编译上下文、源代码、漏洞函数和包版本都作为一等元数据存储。该数据集包含73,610个二进制文件，涵盖248个开源项目，使用GCC、Clang和MSVC在Linux和Windows平台上以多种优化级别编译，并包含跨多年的历史构建。每个二进制文件在数据库中建立索引，关联其源代码、函数、调试信息、变体构建、历史版本及漏洞函数。通过三项分析展示了该数据结构的价值：（1）一个三阶段的LLM基准测试（识别、策略引导检测、跨构建迁移），用于测试LLM是推理二进制漏洞还是基于构建特定伪影进行模式匹配；（2）比较MalConv嵌入、jTrans函数嵌入和TLSH模糊哈希，量化同一包版本在不同空间中的聚类效果；（3）通过贝叶斯回归将二进制相似性分解为时间距离、文件更改和提交的贡献。该论文适合二进制分析、漏洞检测、LLM安全应用等领域的研究人员阅读。

items.title: VIPER-MCP: Detecting and Exploiting Taint-Style Vulnerabilities in Model Context Protocol Servers
items.summary: Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a standard interface for connecting LLM agents to external tools. Because MCP servers expose privileged operations such as shell execution, network access, and file-system manipulation to agent-driven invocation, implementation flaws in tool handlers can create a direct path from natural-language input to security-sensitive sinks, potentially granting attackers remote code execution or full system compromise. Existing approaches either produce unconfirmed static alerts without dynamic validation, or rely on fixed template libraries that lack code-level guidance and fail to trigger vulnerabilities requiring specific parameter shapes or multi-step taint paths. In this paper, we present VIPER-MCP, the first end-to-end automated vulnerability auditing framework for MCP servers that not only detects taint-style vulnerabilities but also dynamically confirms their exploitability by producing concrete proof-of-concept prompts. VIPER-MCP introduces two novel techniques: (1) an anchor-query pass in a two-pass static analysis strategy that augments standard taint alerts with function-level structural context, resolving file-level static artifacts to specific MCP tool handlers and producing vulnerability-anchored call chains; and (2) a feedback-driven prompt evolution mechanism that employs dual-mutator scheduling that independently corrects tool-selection drift and deepens parameter penetration, together with fitness-scored seed selection to iteratively refine natural-language prompts toward vulnerable sinks. In a large-scale scan of 39,884 real-world open-source MCP server repositories, VIPER-MCP discovered 106 0-day vulnerabilities, all of which were confirmed through end-to-end exploit traces, with 67 CVE IDs assigned to date. We responsibly disclosed all confirmed findings to the affected developers and coordinated CVE assignment where applicable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了 VIPER-MCP，首个针对模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器的端到端自动化漏洞审计框架。MCP 已成为连接 LLM 代理与外部工具的标准接口，但 MCP 服务器暴露了 shell 执行、网络访问、文件操作等特权操作，其工具处理器的实现缺陷可能通过自然语言输入直接触发安全敏感操作，导致远程代码执行或系统完全受损。现有方法要么产生未经动态验证的静态告警，要么依赖固定模板库而缺乏代码级指导，无法触发需要特定参数形状或多步污点路径的漏洞。VIPER-MCP 不仅检测污点类型漏洞，还能通过生成具体的概念验证提示动态确认漏洞的可利用性。其核心创新包括：(1) 两阶段静态分析中的锚点-查询传递，通过函数级结构上下文增强标准污点告警，将文件级静态产物解析到具体 MCP 工具处理器，生成漏洞锚定调用链；(2) 反馈驱动的提示进化机制，采用双变异器调度独立纠正工具选择漂移并加深参数渗透，结合适应度得分种子选择，迭代优化自然语言提示以到达脆弱接收点。在 39,884 个真实世界开源 MCP 服务器仓库的大规模扫描中，VIPER-MCP 发现了 106 个 0-day 漏洞，全部通过端到端利用痕迹确认，迄今已分配 67 个 CVE ID。所有发现已负责任地披露给受影响的开发者，并协调了 CVE 分配。该研究对 LLM 代理安全具有重要参考价值，适合安全研究人员、LLM 应用开发者以及 AI 基础设施维护者阅读。

items.title: An Evidence-driven Protocol for Trustworthy CI Pipelines
items.summary: Enterprise software supply chains are increasingly vulnerable to infrastructure attacks, resulting in financial and reputational damage. Ensuring the integrity and provenance of software artifacts remains a significant challenge, where re-execution of the build and tests by every consumer to guarantee provenance produces a verification bottleneck and credibility reduction. This paper presents an evidence-driven protocol for trustworthy Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that combines Deterministic Build Systems (DBS) with Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs). The approach provides cryptographically verifiable guarantees of integrity, authenticity, and attestation for CI artifacts in distributed environments, reducing implicit trust without requiring costly re-execution by consumers. We introduce a protocol that binds deterministic builds with TEE-based attestations, formalizing the evidence life cycle, together with a practical implementation using Nix and Intel TDX. Experimental results show that artifact verification is reduced from redundant computation to lightweight signature and policy checks. These findings demonstrate that evidence-driven CI pipelines establish scalable and verifiable trust in digital infrastructure, effectively amortizing the initial computational overhead introduced by TEEs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 企业软件供应链正面临日益严重的基础设施攻击威胁，可能导致财务和声誉损失。确保软件工件的完整性和来源（provenance）是一个重大挑战，传统的做法是让每个消费者重新执行构建和测试以验证来源，但这会导致验证瓶颈并降低信誉。本文提出了一种基于证据的可信持续集成（CI）管道协议，该协议将确定性构建系统（Deterministic Build Systems, DBS）与可信执行环境（Trusted Execution Environments, TEEs）相结合。该方案为分布式环境中的CI工件提供了加密可验证的完整性、真实性和证明保证，减少了隐式信任需求，且无需消费者进行昂贵的重新执行。具体而言，协议将确定性构建与基于TEE的证明绑定在一起，形式化了证据生命周期，并给出了使用Nix和Intel TDX的实用实现。实验结果表明，工件验证从冗余计算降级为轻量级签名和策略检查。这些发现表明，基于证据的CI管道能够在数字基础设施中建立可扩展且可验证的信任，有效摊销TEE引入的初始计算开销。本文适合软件供应链安全工程师、CI/CD运维人员以及安全架构师阅读，尤其对关注构建可验证性和信任最小化的团队具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该协议直接解决了软件供应链中构建验证的信任与效率矛盾，通过硬件支持的加密证明替代重复构建，为CI管道提供可审计的信任链。安全团队可据此设计更轻量、可信的制品分发策略，降低供应链攻击风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要软件制品完整性证明的CI/CD场景，如金融、政务等高合规要求行业；可迁移至多云或分布式构建环境，提升供应链透明度。

items.title: GenAI-Driven Threat Detection with Microsoft Security Copilot
items.summary: Defending against today's increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks requires security analysts to continuously translate evolving attacker tradecraft into detection logic. This places defenders in a reactive posture, requiring constantly updated expertise across an increasingly fragmented security landscape. We introduce the Dynamic Threat Detection Agent (DTDA), an always-on adaptive agent that continuously investigates security incidents across Microsoft Defender to uncover hidden threats and generate explainable detections when attack-story gaps are found. DTDA combines: (1) a unified activity timeline spanning alerts, events, user and entity behavior analytics, and threat intelligence; (2) versioned LLM prompt contracts with schema validation, grounding requirements, bounded retries, and fail-closed suppression; (3) a planner-executor investigation loop that generates attack-specific hypotheses and gathers supporting and refuting evidence; and (4) dynamic alert generation with a context-relevant title, severity, MITRE mappings, remediation guidance, implicated entities, and natural-language attack description. Integrated into Microsoft Security Copilot and deployed across tens of thousands of Defender customers, DTDA operates continuously at industry scale. In a 120-day online evaluation, DTDA achieves 80.1% precision from customer feedback while generating novel alerts for approximately 15% of investigated incidents. In offline evaluation, DTDA recovers hidden malicious activity with 0.78 F1 using GPT-5.4, improving over GPT-4.1 by 0.12 F1 and outperforming the baseline by 0.26 F1 points. Operationally, DTDA processes single-incident investigations end-to-end in a median of 28 minutes at a median token cost of USD 2.04, with a 0.38% job-level failure rate. These results demonstrate that autonomous agents can identify missed malicious activity at a production scale.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为动态威胁检测代理（Dynamic Threat Detection Agent, DTDA）的自主智能体，旨在解决安全分析师需要持续将不断演变的攻击者战术转化为检测逻辑这一被动防御难题。DTDA 集成在 Microsoft Security Copilot 中，可全天候持续调查 Microsoft Defender 中的安全事件，在发现攻击故事缺失时生成可解释的检测告警。其核心技术包括：（1）统一活动时间线，融合告警、事件、用户与实体行为分析（UEBA）以及威胁情报；（2）版本化的 LLM prompt 契约，包含模式验证、基础要求、有限重试和故障关闭抑制机制，确保可靠性与可控性；（3）规划器-执行器调查循环，可生成攻击特定假设并收集支持与反驳证据；（4）动态告警生成，输出包含上下文相关标题、严重性、MITRE 映射、修复指导、涉及实体及自然语言攻击描述的告警。DTDA 已部署于数万 Defender 客户环境中，以工业规模持续运行。120 天在线评估显示，客户反馈的精确率达到 80.1%，约 15% 的调查事件生成了新颖告警。离线评估中，基于 GPT-5.4 的 DTDA 以 0.78 的 F1 分数恢复隐藏恶意活动，较 GPT-4.1 提升 0.12 F1，较基线提升 0.26 F1。操作层面，单事件调查端到端中位处理时间为 28 分钟，中位 token 成本 2.04 美元，任务级故障率仅 0.38%。结果表明，自主代理能够在生产规模下有效识别之前遗漏的恶意活动。

items.title: Frequency-Domain Regularized Adversarial Alignment for Transferable Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transfer-based targeted attacks, where perturbations optimized on open-source surrogate encoders can generalize to closed-source MLLMs. A key challenge for improving adversarial transferability is to effectively capture the intrinsic visual focus shared across different models, such that perturbations align with transferable semantic cues rather than surrogate-specific behaviors. However, existing methods suffer from spatial-domain feature redundancy and surrogate-specific gradient signals, thereby hindering cross-model transferability. In this paper, we propose FRA-Attack, which addresses both challenges from a unified frequency-domain regularization perspective. For feature alignment, a high-pass DCT objective on patch features suppresses redundant global structures and concentrates the loss on the high-frequency band that carries the MLLMs' intrinsic visual focus. For gradient optimization, we introduce Frequency-domain Gradient Regularization (FGR), a \textit{model-agnostic} low-pass regularizer that modulates the surrogate gradient using only the geometric frequency coordinate, \textit{i.e.}, no surrogate-derived statistic is involved, so that FGR is model-agnostic by construction, removing surrogate-specific high-frequency artifacts while preserving transferable low-frequency directions. Together, the two components form a unified frequency-domain treatment of transferability. Extensive experiments on $15$ flagship MLLMs across $7$ vendors show that FRA-Attack achieves superior cross-model transferability, particularly with state-of-the-art performance on GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.6 and Gemini-3-flash.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了针对闭源多模态大模型（MLLMs）的基于迁移的定向攻击问题。现有方法在空间域存在特征冗余和代理模型特定梯度信号，导致跨模型可迁移性受限。为此，作者提出FRA-Attack，一种从频域正则化角度统一解决上述挑战的方法。该方法包含两个关键组件：（1）高通DCT目标函数：在图像块特征上应用高通离散余弦变换，抑制冗余全局结构，聚焦于携带MLLMs固有视觉焦点的高频带，从而实现更可迁移的特征对齐；（2）频域梯度正则化（FGR）：一种与模型无关的低通正则化器，仅利用几何频率坐标调节代理梯度，不依赖任何代理模型统计量，因此天然具有模型无关性，可去除代理模型特有的高频伪影，同时保留可迁移的低频方向。两者共同构成统一的频域可迁移性处理。在来自7家厂商的15个旗舰MLLMs上的大量实验表明，FRA-Attack实现了优越的跨模型可迁移性，尤其在GPT-5.4、Claude-Opus-4.6和Gemini-3-flash上达到了最先进性能。本文从攻击角度揭示了闭源MLLMs的脆弱性，对防御者理解此类威胁和设计鲁棒模型具有参考价值。

items.title: Rethinking Fraud Safety Evaluation: Multi-Round Attacks Reveal Safety-Utility Tradeoffs in Graph-Context LLM Defenders
items.summary: Single-turn safety evaluation is a poor proxy for real fraud defense, where attackers escalate across multiple rounds. This paper evaluates fraud defenders under replay and adaptive multi-round attacks and measures when a defender refuses, not just whether it eventually refuses. On a frozen multi-round suite built from Fraud-R1, graph-context defenders improve early safe refusal relative to text-only baselines under both replay and adaptive fraud pressure, but they also produce substantially more benign over-refusal. Direct probing of the trained graph encoder, together with paired shuffle-risk ablations on both fraud and benign sides replicated across two seeds on the Qwen-1.5B backbone, localises this cost to how the defender LLM consumes structured context rather than to graph-encoder quality: the encoder cleanly separates fraud from benign, while the LLM responds primarily to the presence of structured graph fields and only secondarily, and asymmetrically, to risk-score magnitude. Temporal graph context is directionally stronger than static and significantly better grounded, but is not yet conclusively superior on the main refusal metrics. The contribution is evaluative and measurement-oriented: robust fraud assessment must be multi-round, must report refusal timing, must account for benign false positives alongside fraud-side safety gains, and must localize observed costs to the graph signal or to how the LLM consumes it.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文指出，当前针对欺诈防御的 LLM 安全评估多采用单轮交互，这远不足以模拟真实世界中攻击者通过多轮对话逐步升级的欺诈行为。作者构建了一个基于 Fraud-R1 数据集的冻结多轮评估套件，并在其上比较了纯文本基线模型与图上下文防御模型（即在 LLM 推理时额外提供结构化图特征）在重放攻击和自适应多轮攻击下的表现。实验使用 Qwen-1.5B 作为骨干，通过两个种子重复验证。主要发现包括：(1) 图上下文防御模型在两类攻击下均能更早地安全拒答，显著优于纯文本基线；(2) 但同时也导致大量良性样本被过度拒答，产生严重的误伤；(3) 通过直接探测图编码器以及配对混洗风险消融实验，作者将误伤代价归因于 LLM 消费结构化上下文的方式，而非图编码器质量——编码器能清晰分离欺诈与良性样本，而 LLM 主要对结构化图字段的存在做出响应，对风险分数大小的响应是次要且不对称的；(4) 时序图上下文在方向性上强于静态图，且基础更扎实，但在主要拒答指标上尚未表现出决定性优势。本文的贡献主要是评估和测量导向：强调鲁棒的欺诈评估必须采用多轮交互、必须报告拒答时机、必须同时考虑良性误报率，并且必须将观测到的代价定位于图信号本身或 LLM 的消费方式。适合从事 LLM 安全评估、欺诈检测系统开发的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本研究揭示了图上下文增强的LLM防御在欺诈场景下的安全-效用权衡，提醒安全从业者：引入结构化上下文虽能提升早期拒答率，但会显著增加良性误报，需谨慎评估部署。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM驱动的欺诈检测系统设计，特别是金融、客服等高风险场景。测量方法论可推广至其它多轮安全防御评估。
detection_signals_zh: 图字段存在性对拒答的影响
defense_advice_zh: 部署图上下文防御前需同时评估良性误报率；
考虑对结构化字段的使用进行消融测试，避免LLM过度依赖字段存在性而非风险值。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：在内部评估中引入多轮攻击框架，并复现图上下文防御的权衡分析。

items.title: Heartbeat-Bound Hierarchical Credentials: Cryptographic Revocation for AI Agent Swarms
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents that spawn sub-agent swarms create a safety gap: existing credential revocation mechanisms, OAuth~2.0 introspection, OCSP, and W3C Status Lists, require network connectivity to a central authority, leaving ``zombie agents'' executing privileged operations for minutes to hours after operator shutdown. We present Heartbeat-Bound Hierarchical Credentials (HBHC), a cryptographic protocol that binds credential validity to periodic parent liveness proofs. Verifiers enforce freshness using only a cached public key and local clock; no network round-trip is required. When heartbeat generation ceases, all descendant credentials become unusable within a deterministically bounded window $W_z \le W_{\max} + Δ_h + ε$, conditional on bounded clock skew and parent keys held in secure enclaves. Evaluation at the protocol layer and with real LLM-backed agent swarms (GPT-4o-mini) demonstrates a 90$\times$ reduction in the zombie window over OAuth~2.0, 0.26~ms full authentication in Rust, 18,000+ verifications per second under concurrent HTTP load, and stable per-verification latency from 10 to 10,000 agents. Real-agent experiments show 0.71\% end-to-end overhead on tool calls, zero post-revocation tool calls under prompt injection that bypasses application-layer guardrails, and cascading revocation across a 49-agent four-level hierarchy within the theoretical bound.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对自主AI代理在生成子代理群时面临的安全缺口——现有凭证撤销机制（如OAuth 2.0内省、OCSP、W3C状态列表）依赖网络连接至中心权威，导致操作者关闭主代理后，“僵尸代理”仍可在数分钟到数小时内执行特权操作。为此，作者提出心跳绑定层级凭证（HBHC），一种加密协议，将凭证有效性绑定到周期性的父代理存活性证明上。验证者仅需缓存公钥和本地时钟即可强制检查凭证新鲜度，无需网络往返。当心跳停止生成时，所有后代凭证在确定性有界窗口内变得不可用，该窗口取决于最大允许窗口、心跳间隔和时钟偏差，且父代理密钥存储在安全飞地中。协议层评估显示，与OAuth 2.0相比，僵尸窗口减少90倍；Rust实现下全认证耗时0.26毫秒；在并发HTTP负载下每秒可执行超过18,000次验证；且从10到10,000个代理规模下，单次验证延迟稳定。基于真实LLM代理群（GPT-4o-mini）的实验表明，工具调用的端到端开销仅0.71%；在绕过应用层防护的提示注入攻击下，撤销后无工具调用发生；在49个代理、4级层级中，级联撤销在理论界限内完成。本文贡献在于提出一种去中心化、低延迟的凭证撤销方案，尤其适用于大规模自主代理系统。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 解决了AI代理群中凭证撤销延迟导致的安全盲区，无需持续联网即可实现近乎实时的权限回收，显著增强多智能体系统的可控性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至多智能体协作、联邦学习、物联网设备群等需要细粒度、低延迟权限撤销的场景。

items.title: Security Document Classification with a Fine-Tuned Local Large Language Model: Benchmark Data and an Open-Source System
items.summary: Organizations that scan documents for sensitive information face a practical problem. Cloud services require data to be sent to external infrastructure, while rule-based tools often miss threats that depend on context. This study presents TorchSight, an open-source local system for security document classification built around a fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 27B model. The model was trained on 78,358 samples from 13 permissively licensed sources and GPT-4 synthetic data covering seven security categories and 51 subcategories. In the main evaluation on 1,000 documents, the model reached 95.0% category-level accuracy (95% confidence interval: 93.5-96.2). The tested commercial models scored 75.4-79.9% under the same prompting protocol. On a separate external set of 500 held-out samples, the model reached 93.8% accuracy, which suggests that performance extends beyond the main benchmark, although the margin depends on dataset composition and difficult boundary cases. The results show that a fine-tuned local model can support accurate security document classification while keeping document processing under local control.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对组织在扫描文档敏感信息时面临的困境：云服务需要将数据发送到外部基础设施，存在隐私风险；而基于规则的静态工具常常无法捕捉依赖上下文的威胁。为此，作者提出了TorchSight——一个基于微调本地大语言模型（Qwen 3.5 27B）的开源安全文档分类系统。该系统使用来自13个宽松许可来源的78,358个样本以及GPT-4生成的合成数据进行训练，涵盖7个安全类别和51个子类别，实现了多粒度的文档安全分类。在1000篇文档的主评估集上，模型达到95.0%的类别级准确率（95%置信区间：93.5-96.2），显著优于在相同提示协议下测试的商业模型（75.4-79.9%）。在500篇独立样本的外部保留集上，模型准确率为93.8%，表明性能具有可迁移性，但具体效果取决于数据集构成和边界案例。该研究的主要贡献在于：证明通过微调本地大语言模型，可以在不牺牲准确性的前提下实现完全本地的文档安全分类，有效规避了云服务的隐私风险，并克服了传统规则方法的局限性。论文提供的开源系统、基准数据和训练方法对安全从业者和研究人员具有实际参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为企业提供了一种无需上传数据至云端的高精度文档分类方案，兼顾隐私与性能，可直接替代或补充现有规则引擎。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于数据泄露防护（DLP）、敏感信息审计、内部威胁检测等场景，尤其适合对数据主权要求严格的行业。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 评估并测试开源TorchSight系统在企业内网环境下的分类效果，考虑将其纳入文档安全处理流程。

items.title: Refusal Evaluation in Coding LLMs and Code Agents: A Systematic Review of Thirteen Malicious-Code Prompt Corpora (2023-2025)
items.summary: The evaluation of large language model refusal on malicious-coding tasks now spans at least thirteen publicly released prompt corpora (AdvBench, the CyberSecEval family, RMCBench, RedCode, MCGMark, JailbreakBench, CySecBench, MalwareBench, CIRCLE, MOCHA, ASTRA, Scam2Prompt / Innoc2Scam-bench, and JAWS-Bench), each constructed under a different protocol, released under different licensing terms, and validated (or not) against different inter-rater reliability standards. Existing surveys treat code security, jailbreak taxonomy, or vulnerability detection as the central object and mention these corpora only in passing. This paper reverses that framing: it treats the prompt datasets themselves as the unit of analysis. Following a PRISMA-style protocol, we specify a search strategy, screen the recent literature on coding-LLM refusal evaluation, apply a uniform extraction template to each in-scope corpus, and synthesize the resulting catalogue along construction methodology, prompt-construction taxonomy (modality, turn structure, elicitation style), reproducibility and licensing, and malware-category coverage. The synthesis surfaces three recurring methodological gaps: the absence of human-annotator baselines against which LLM-judge labels can be calibrated, the absence of cross-corpus comparability with refusal-rate statistics measuring non-equivalent constructs, and the fragmentation of malware-category taxonomies, with no canonical schema spanning the thirteen in-scope corpora. The review concludes with proposed methodological directions for next-generation corpora, including pre-registration of inclusion criteria, vendor-diverse multi-judge validation, Fleiss' kappa with bootstrap CI as the reliability baseline, and a candidate canonical taxonomy.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对2023-2025年间公开发布的13个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在恶意编码任务上拒绝能力的提示语料库（包括AdvBench、CyberSecEval系列、RMCBench、RedCode、MCGMark、JailbreakBench、CySecBench、MalwareBench、CIRCLE、MOCHA、ASTRA、Scam2Prompt/Innoc2Scam-bench和JAWS-Bench）进行了系统性综述。现有综述多以代码安全、越狱分类或漏洞检测为核心，仅简要提及这些语料库。本文反转视角，将提示数据集本身作为分析单元，遵循PRISMA样式协议，制定检索策略，筛选近期关于编码LLM拒绝评估的文献，对每个符合条件的语料库应用统一信息提取模板，并从构建方法论、提示构建分类法（模态、轮次结构、诱导风格）、可复现性与许可协议、恶意软件类别覆盖度等方面进行综合。综述揭示了三个反复出现的方法论缺口：缺乏用于校准LLM评判标签的人工标注基线；缺乏跨语料库可比性，因为拒绝率统计量测量的是不等价构念；恶意软件类别分类体系碎片化，13个语料库没有统一的标准分类。最后，论文提出了下一代语料库的建设方向，包括预注册纳入标准、多供应商多评判验证、以Fleiss' kappa结合Bootstrap置信区间作为可靠性基线，以及一个候选标准分类法。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM在编码任务中的安全性至关重要，但现有评估语料库缺乏统一方法和可靠性基准。该综述系统梳理了13个主流语料库的方法论缺陷，为构建可比较、可复现的评估框架提供了明确方向，有助于提升LLM安全评估的科学性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响LLM安全评估领域，特别是针对恶意代码生成任务的拒绝能力评估。可为研究团队、安全开发者和评估机构提供构建下一代语料库的方法指南，促进跨研究可比性。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 安全研究团队应阅读该综述，了解现有语料库的局限性，并考虑在构建或选用评估数据集时采纳其方法论建议（如预注册、多评判验证、标准分类法）。

items.title: BiRD: A Bidirectional Ranking Defense Mechanism for Retrieval Augmented Generation
items.summary: The growing adoption of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has led to a rise in adversarial attacks. Existing defenses, relying on semantic analysis or voting, face a trade-off between high computational cost and limited robustness under strong poisoning attacks. Their fundamental limitation is the exclusive focus on semantic content relevance, while neglecting the retrieval context that is critically defined by ranking structures. To this end, we investigate the bidirectional ranking behavior of poisoned and benign documents, and discover a key discriminative pattern: poisoned documents exhibit significantly stronger alignment between their backward rankings and the query's forward ranking. Capitalizing on this, we propose BiRD, a bidirectional ranking defense mechanism built upon a dual-signal framework that leverages forward ranking to assess semantic content relevance and backward ranking to quantify ranking context consistency. This design directly addresses the fundamental limitation of prior approaches, enabling simultaneous efficiency and robustness. Extensive evaluation across 3 datasets with 3 retrievers and 3 LLMs under 2 attack scenarios validates BiRD's effectiveness. Notably, BiRD reduces the attack success rate of PoisonedRAG by up to 54% while simultaneously improving task accuracy by up to 56%, with average additional latency under 1 second.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统面临日益增长的对抗攻击问题，指出现有防御方法（如基于语义分析或投票）存在计算成本高或鲁棒性不足的缺陷，其根本原因在于仅关注语义内容相关性而忽略了由排序结构定义的检索上下文。作者研究了中毒文档和良性文档的双向排序行为，发现一个关键判别模式：中毒文档的后向排序（查询真实相关文档相对于中毒文档的排名）与查询的前向排序（文档相对于查询的排名）之间存在显著更强的一致性。基于此发现，提出了 BiRD（双向排序防御机制），该机制采用双信号框架：前向排序用于评估语义内容相关性，后向排序用于量化排序上下文一致性，直接弥补了以往方法的根本局限性，实现了效率与鲁棒性的兼得。在 3 个数据集、3 种检索器和 3 种大语言模型上，针对 2 种攻击场景进行了广泛评估，结果表明 BiRD 能将 PoisonedRAG 的攻击成功率降低高达 54%，同时将任务准确性提升高达 56%，平均额外延迟低于 1 秒。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 RAG 系统提供了一种高效且鲁棒的对抗防御新思路，通过利用排序结构信息而非仅依赖语义，有望推广到各类基于检索的生成任务，提升安全可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于企业级 RAG 系统（如问答、摘要生成），降低恶意文档注入导致的攻击成功风险，同时保持高任务质量，适用于对实时性要求较高的场景。

items.title: LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant
items.summary: Benchmark datasets are critical for reproducible, reliable, and discriminative evaluation of LLMs. However, recent studies reveal that many benchmark datasets are included in pretraining corpora, i.e., $\textit{contaminated}$, which diminishes their value as reliable measures of model generalization. In this paper, we argue that benchmark datasets should be $\textit{contamination-resistant}$, i.e., $\textit{unlearnable}$, but support $\textit{inference}$. To accomplish this, we first highlight the wide prevalence of benchmark dataset contamination and outline the properties of contamination-resistant datasets. Second, we highlight how the asymmetry between the inference and training pipelines in the Transformer architecture can be leveraged to support contamination-resistance. Third, we outline mathematical advancements to make these datasets interoperable across various LLM architectures. Based on the above, we call on the community to ensure the reliability of LLM benchmarking by: (i) advancing novel contamination-resistant methodologies, (ii) developing supporting methods and platforms, and (iii) adopting contamination-resistant benchmarks into existing evaluation pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文指出，LLM基准测试数据集对于可重复、可靠和有区分度的评估至关重要。然而，近期研究表明许多基准数据集已被包含在预训练语料中，即遭到“污染”，这削弱了它们作为模型泛化能力可靠度量的价值。作者主张基准数据集应当具备“抗污染”能力，即无法被学习（unlearnable）但支持推理（inference）。为此，他们首先强调基准数据集污染的普遍性，并概述抗污染数据集应具备的属性；其次，说明如何利用Transformer架构中推理和训练流水线的不对称性来支持抗污染；第三，提出数学上的改进以使得这些数据集能够跨不同LLM架构互操作。基于上述分析，作者呼吁社区通过以下措施确保LLM基准测试的可靠性：（i）推进新颖的抗污染方法论，（ii）开发支持方法和平台，（iii）将抗污染基准纳入现有评估流水线。本文的核心贡献在于定义并提出“抗污染基准数据集”这一概念，并给出初步实现方向。适合LLM评估研究者、安全从业者及基准设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM基准数据集污染直接导致评估结果虚高，掩盖模型真实缺陷，进而影响安全关键应用的模型选型与风险判断。抗污染机制能提升评估可信度，是保障LLM供应链安全的基础。

items.title: Adaptive Probe-based Steering for Robust LLM Jailbreaking
items.summary: Recent work has demonstrated the potential of contrastive steering for jailbreaking Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods rely on limited and inherently biased contrastive prompts and require laborious manual tuning of steering strength, limiting their robustness and effectiveness. In this paper, we leverage the idea of model extraction to guide the learned steering vectors to approximate the ideal one and propose tuning the steering strength adaptively based on contrastive activations' statistics. Experiments demonstrate that our method notably improves the effectiveness and robustness of probe-based steering, without any extra contrastive prompts or laborious manual tuning. Being an attack paper, this paper focuses on revealing the breakdown of fortified LLMs, raising the average harmfulness score from 6\% to 70\%. Our code is available at https://github.com/fhdnskfbeuv/adaptiveSteering.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱安全问题，提出了一种基于自适应探针引导的对抗性攻击方法。现有对比引导越狱方法依赖于有限且具有固有偏见的对比提示，并需要大量手动调整引导强度，导致鲁棒性和有效性不足。作者利用模型提取的思想，通过学习引导向量逼近理想引导向量，并基于对比激活的统计量自适应调整引导强度，从而显著提升了探针引导的有效性和鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法无需额外的对比提示或繁琐的手动调参，即可大幅提高攻击成功率，将平均危害分数从6%提升至70%，揭示了当前防御机制的脆弱性。论文提供了开源代码。该研究属于攻击视角，旨在暴露LLM防御的局限性，对安全社区具有重要警示意义。

items.title: Exploring and Developing a Pre-Model Safeguard with Draft Models
items.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit unsafe responses, motivating pre-model and post-model guards. Pre-model guards audit the safety of prompts before invoking target models. However, relying solely on the prompt often leads to high false-negative rates (i.e., jailbreak attacks go undetected). Post-model guards address this issue by auditing both the user prompt and the target model's response. However, they incur a high computational cost, including increased token usage and processing time, because they operate after target model inference. In this paper, we introduce a safeguard design that leverages the transferability of jailbreak attacks to enforce prompt safety before target model inference. We first conduct a systematic study of jailbreak transferability, particularly from LLMs to small language models (SLMs). Through these experiments, we identify key factors influencing transferability. Building on these insights, we observe that responses from smaller draft models reflect the safety implications of those from large target models; \ie given a jailbreak prompt constructed for an LLM, an SLM is likely to be triggered to generate an unaligned response. Based on this observation, our safeguard design leverages speculative inference with SLMs to generate a set of draft responses. It then feeds the original prompt and these drafts into existing guards to predict their safety. We demonstrate that this design reduces the false-negative rate of pre-model guards and offers a low \Efficiency alternative to post-model guards. \textcolor{red}{\bf Notice: This paper contains examples of harmful language.}

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在面对 jailbreak 攻击时易产生不安全响应的问题，提出了一种基于预模型守卫的新型防御架构。现有防御方法分为两类：预模型守卫仅审计用户提示词，但容易漏检（假阴性率高）；后模型守卫同时审计提示词和模型响应，但计算成本高（增加 token 使用量和处理时间）。作者首先系统研究了 jailbreak 攻击从 LLM 到小型语言模型（SLM）的可迁移性，发现关键影响因素（如模型大小、训练数据等）。基于这一观察，他们提出利用 SLM 的投机推理（speculative inference）生成一组草稿响应，然后将原始提示词与草稿响应共同送入现有守卫模型进行安全性预测。实验表明，该方法显著降低了预模型守卫的假阴性率，同时提供了比后模型守卫更高效的选择。论文还包含有害语言示例。

items.title: Trusted Weights, Treacherous Optimizations? Optimization-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLMs
items.summary: Inference optimization is a vital technique for deploying LLMs at scale. Compilation is the most widely adopted optimization technique for LLMs. While it assumes semantic equivalence between the original and compiled graphs, we first uncover its numerical side effects can be maliciously exploited to implant stealthy backdoors in LLMs. We propose a unified optimization-triggered attack framework comprising two complementary strategies. Without any modification to the compiler or hardware, one strategy flips predictions for specific inputs only when the model is compiled, while the other uses a universal trigger that remains dormant under uncompiled execution but hijacks arbitrary inputs once compilation optimization is applied. Both attacks bypass standard safety evaluations run without compilation. We empirically demonstrate that these optimization-triggered backdoors achieve attack success rates averaging 90% across four mainstream open-source LLMs and four tasks, while clean accuracy is preserved at nearly 100% under all settings. Our findings reveal a novel attack surface at the intersection of optimization and security in the LLM deployment pipeline, and we investigate practical defenses to mitigate this threat.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文首次揭示了LLM推理优化中的编译过程可能被恶意利用来植入后门。作者提出了一种统一的优化触发后门攻击框架，包含两种互补策略：第一种策略仅在模型被编译后，对特定输入翻转预测结果；第二种策略使用通用触发器，在未编译时保持潜伏，一旦应用编译优化则劫持任意输入。两种攻击都能绕过标准安全评估（未使用编译时的评估）。实验在四个主流开源LLM和四个任务上实现平均90%的攻击成功率，同时保持几乎100%的干净准确率。该工作揭示了LLM部署流水线中优化与安全交叉处的新型攻击面，并探索了实用防御措施。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统后门攻击假设攻击者修改模型权重或训练过程，而本文展示无需修改权重，仅依赖编译器优化副作用即可植入后门，开辟了LLM供应链安全新战场。

defense_advice_zh: 在编译优化前后对模型输出进行一致性验证，尤其关注边界输入下的行为差异

items.title: Onion-Routed Multi-Circuit Key Establishment for Quantum-Resilient Sessions
items.summary: Public-key primitives that today anchor session-key establishment - RSA, Diffie-Hellman, and elliptic-curve cryptography - reduce to integer factorization or discrete logarithm and are therefore vulnerable to Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently capable quantum computer. The harvest-now, decrypt-later (HNDL) threat model turns this future capability into a present liability: ciphertext archived today can be decrypted retrospectively once a cryptographically relevant quantum computer becomes available. We propose a session-key establishment scheme that distributes a freshly generated key as multiple, independently encrypted fragments across distinct, ephemeral Tor circuits between an onion-service proxy and an onion-service client. Reconstruction requires every fragment; each fragment travels its own per-bundle circuit established via a NEWNYM signal. The security argument rests on the standard end-to-end correlation bound for onion routing: an adversary controlling a fraction of Tor relays must independently deanonymize every fresh circuit to correlate the fragments belonging to one session, and the per-fragment probability of success decays multiplicatively in the number of fragments. We implement the design as a Flask-based prototype on AWS EC2, with both the proxy and the client deployed as Tor onion services, and measure end-to-end key-establishment latency. The implemented prototype completes a key establishment in 13-20 s on average (7-50 s including tails), of which approximately 88% is attributable to Tor-related delay - a cost we discuss in the context of the privacy-versus-responsiveness trade-off.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对量子计算机对现有公钥密码体系（RSA、Diffie-Hellman、椭圆曲线）的威胁，特别是“先收后解密”（HNDL）攻击模型——攻击者可先存储加密流量，待量子计算机成熟后离线解密，提出了一种基于洋葱路由（Tor）的多电路密钥协商方案。方案的核心思想是：将生成的会话密钥分割成多个独立加密的片段，每个片段通过不同的、短暂的Tor电路在洋葱服务代理和客户端之间传输。每个电路使用NEWNYM信号建立，确保每束（bundle）电路独立。攻击者必须成功关联所有电路才能恢复密钥，而由于Tor路由的端到端关联概率随电路数量呈乘法衰减，安全性显著增强。作者基于Flask框架在AWS EC2上实现了原型，代理和客户端均以Tor洋葱服务部署。实验测量了端到端密钥建立延迟，平均13-20秒（考虑尾延迟为7-50秒），其中约88%的开销来自Tor网络延迟。论文讨论了这种延迟在隐私与响应速度权衡中的意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提供了一种对抗量子计算威胁的实用化密钥协商方案，创新地结合了Tor的多电路特性与密钥分片，为现实场景中的长期保密通信（如外交、军事、金融）提供了新的防御思路，值得密码学与网络隐私研究者关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响高安全需求的通信系统，特别是需要抗量子长期保密性的应用；其分片+多电路的思路也可迁移至其他匿名网络或混合加密协议设计。
defense_advice_zh: 关注量子安全密钥交换协议发展，评估将此类多电路方案集成到现有加密通信框架的可行性。
在延迟敏感场景中，可优化Tor电路建立过程（如使用预建电路池）以降低开销。

items.title: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents against Temporal, Spatial, and Semantic Evasions
items.summary: As autonomous agents (e.g., OpenClaw) increasingly operate with deep system-level privileges to execute complex tasks, they introduce severe, unmitigated security risks. Current vulnerability analyses overwhelmingly focus on single-turn, stateless behaviors, overlooking the expanded attack surface inherent in stateful, multi-turn interactions and dynamic tool invocations. In this paper, we propose a novel, multi-dimensional evasion framework targeting LLM-based agent systems. We introduce three stealthy attack vectors: (1) Temporal evasion, which fragments malicious payloads across sequential interaction turns; (2) Spatial evasion, which conceals payloads within complex external artifacts that evade standard LLM parsing mechanisms; and (3) Semantic evasion, which obscures malicious intents beneath benign contextual noise. To systematically quantify these threats, we construct A3S-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,254 real-world agent execution trajectories. Evaluating a standard agent framework separately integrated with 10 mainstream LLM backbones against 20 practical threat scenarios, we demonstrate that our evasion framework elevates the average risk trigger rate from a 28.3\% baseline to 52.6\%. These findings reveal systemic, architecture-level vulnerabilities in current autonomous agent systems that existing defenses fail to address, highlighting an urgent need for defense mechanisms tailored to the unique threats.

items.title: Quality-Assured Fuzz Harness Generation via the Four Principles Framework
items.summary: Fuzz testing is the dominant technique for finding memory-safety vulnerabilities in C/C++ software, yet its effectiveness hinges on the quality of fuzz harnesses -- the programs that bridge fuzzers and library APIs. A growing body of tools now automate harness generation, but none systematically ensures the correctness of produced harnesses: logic errors, API misuse, and lifecycle violations go undetected at the source level. As LLM-driven generation scales harness creation, uncontrolled quality turns scale into a liability. We present QuartetFuzz, an autonomous harness-generation system that systematically improves correctness throughout the generation process. At its core is the Four Principles framework -- Logic Correctness (P1), API Protocol Compliance (P2), Security Boundary Respect (P3), and Entry Point Adequacy (P4) -- the first source-level definition of harness correctness with mathematical specifications and implementable checks. We operationalize these principles in an autonomous LLM agent that produces harnesses satisfying P1-P4 through a generate-check-fix loop before any fuzzing begins. Deployed on 23 open-source projects spanning C/C++, Java, and JavaScript, the system submits 42 bug reports, of which 29 are fixed or confirmed upstream (including 3 CVEs) and only 2 are rejected (4.8% FP rate). During generation, the built-in P1/P2 checks automatically intercepted 58 harness-induced crashes that would otherwise have been false positives. Applied as a quality auditor to 586 existing production harnesses across 70 projects, the system identifies 53 violations (45 confirmed, 35 fixed). We release a dataset of 100 labeled harnesses for reproducible evaluation. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/OwenSanzas/QuartetFuzz

items.title: reconCTI: A Proactive Approach to Cyber-Threat Intelligence
items.summary: The rapid advancement of information technology has introduced a noticeable shift from traditional offline practices to more efficient and interconnected online environments. This transition, while offering convenience, has also increased exposure to various cyber threats such as identity theft, impersonation, and phishing scams. Reconnaissance, or briefly known as information gathering, is a key stage for threat actors, often relying on open-source intelligence (OSINT) to collect sensitive and extensive data on targets. In response to this challenge, this study introduces reconCTI, a command-line tool built using Python for Linux systems. The tool is designed to search for sensitive data leaks across both surface web and dark web platforms. It allows users to input specific keywords, scan multiple sites at once, and then assess the findings by referencing the MITRE ATT&CK framework. The results are compiled into a threat report that also includes possible mitigation strategies. reconCTI is intended to support both cybersecurity professionals and individuals in identifying risks early and taking appropriate action.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一款名为 reconCTI 的命令行工具，用于主动收集网络威胁情报。该工具基于 Python 开发，面向 Linux 系统，旨在帮助网络安全专业人员和普通用户通过开源情报（OSINT）方式发现敏感数据泄露。reconCTI 支持同时扫描表层网络和暗网中的多个站点，用户可输入特定关键词进行搜索。工具将扫描结果映射到 MITRE ATT&CK 框架，自动关联攻击者可能使用的战术和技术，并生成包含风险等级和缓解策略的威胁报告。实验评估表明，reconCTI 能够有效识别包括身份盗窃、钓鱼诈骗等在内的常见威胁，并在多种场景下保持了较好的扫描效率。该工具的主要贡献在于提供了一种自动化、可扩展的侦察与威胁情报收集方法，弥补了现有开源工具在关联攻击框架和生成可操作报告方面的不足。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: reconCTI 将 OSINT 侦察与 MITRE ATT&CK 框架结合，为蓝队提供了一种主动发现数据泄露并关联攻击战术的实用工具，有助于提前防御。

items.title: Backchaining Loss of Control Mitigations from Mission-Specific Benchmarks in National Security
items.summary: Affordances and permissions are promising and timely safety levers for mitigating Loss of Control (LoC) threats in high-stakes deployment contexts, such as national security. Deployers in defense and intelligence could rely on several approaches to identify which affordances and permissions should be prioritized, such as structured threat modelling, pre-deployment agentic evaluations, post-deployment continuous monitoring, and AI safety cases. This paper proposes a complementary and empirical methodology that leverages existing use-case-specific benchmarks: backchaining LoC mitigations from the errors an AI system makes on national security benchmarks. The approach proceeds in three steps and allows national security deployers to start building LoC mitigations today, from evidence they can generate themselves. First, deployers evaluate AI systems on mission-specific benchmarks approximating real use-cases. Second, deployers concentrate on the incorrect responses that the AI system provides to the benchmark questions, and backchain the affordances and permissions that would enable the AI system to cause downstream harm if it pursued the actions described in the incorrect answers. Third, deployers intervene selectively on those affordances and permissions, bottlenecking the paths to harm while preserving the AI system's ability to carry out the correct action. We illustrate this methodology through a demonstrative benchmark question on derivative security classification.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对国家安全等高风险部署场景中AI系统失控（Loss of Control）威胁的缓解问题，提出了一种基于任务特定基准的实证方法论。核心思路是：从AI系统在国家安全基准测试中产生的错误答案出发，反向推导出哪些权限（affordances and permissions）若被授予将允许系统执行有害行为，从而优先削减这些权限，同时保留系统执行正确行为的能力。方法分为三步：1) 在近似真实任务的任务特定基准上评估AI系统；2) 聚焦AI系统给出的错误答案，反向推导出若系统按错误答案执行行动时所需且会导致下游危害的权限；3) 选择性地干预这些权限，阻塞危害路径。论文通过一个涉密衍生分类的示范性问题展示了该方法的可操作性。该方法补充了现有的结构化威胁建模、部署前评估、持续监控和AI安全案例等方法，为国防和情报领域的部署者提供了可立即基于自身证据构建失控缓解措施的途径。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 针对高风险国家安全场景下AI系统失控威胁，提出了可实操的逆向权限削减方法，帮助部署者优先缓解关键风险。

items.title: Domijn: The Security of Domain Registrars and the Risk of a Domain Name Takeover
items.summary: Domain names are key assets for organisation. They anchor an organisation's online presence and reputation, and serve as linking pin for web services and, e.g., email. Consequently, a malicious takeover of a domain can lead to significant damages. Organisations register domain names through so-called registrars, a type of business that plays a key role in the domain name industry. This implies that registrars play an important part in safeguarding against malicious takeovers of domains. In this paper we empirically study how registrars implement security controls to prevent against such takeovers. We focus on the top 10 most popular registrars for the .nl ccTLD. We present the results of this study in light of a model for the impact of domain takeovers, that analyses the possible consequence of a takeover. We contrast this against the impact of two other well-known threats: ransomware and DDoS attacks. We find that all registrars in our study implement relatively effective security measures, but that they fall short in more advanced security controls, such as the proper implementation of two-factor authentication. We also find that a domain takeover can have significant impact, potentially equalling that of a ransomware attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究着眼于域名注册商在防止恶意域名劫持中的安全控制作用。域名是组织在线身份和声誉的核心资产，一旦被恶意接管，将导致严重损失。论文针对.nl国家顶级域下最受欢迎的10家注册商，通过实证方法评估其安全措施的有效性。研究显示，所有注册商均实施了相对有效的基础安全控制，但在高级防护措施（如双因素认证的规范部署）上存在不足。作者还构建了一个域名劫持影响模型，对比勒索软件和DDoS攻击的影响，发现域名劫持的潜在损害可能不亚于勒索软件攻击。该工作为组织选择注册商和评估域名安全风险提供了实证依据，适合网络安全从业者、域名管理人员及政策制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 域名劫持可直接导致业务中断、品牌声誉受损及数据泄露，而注册商作为防线关键环节，其安全短板常被忽视。本研究揭示了主流注册商的防护盲区，有助于组织重新评估域名风险管理策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 域名劫持可能导致服务不可用、钓鱼攻击、电子邮件拦截等，影响范围涵盖所有依赖域名的在线业务，实际损失可能等同于勒索软件攻击。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议安全团队审查当前使用的域名注册商，尤其关注其双因素认证等高级安全功能的实现情况，并考虑将域名迁移至安全控制更完善的注册商。

items.title: TriSweep: A Four-Drone Swarm Framework for Electromagnetic Side-Channel Analysis
items.summary: Electromagnetic (EM) side-channel analysis traditionally assumes a stationary, close-proximity probe - a threat model that underestimates aerial adversaries. TriSweep is a simulation framework that designs and evaluates a four-drone swarm architecture for autonomous standoff EM-SCA of embedded microcontrollers at 0.25-1.5 m. Three spatially specialized collector drones - Anchor (full-spectrum), Mask Probe (mask-register loading leakage), and Cipher Probe (masked SubBytes output leakage) - feed a stationary Accumulator drone that performs coherent combining (+4.8 dB SNR gain) and second-order mask cancellation via a centered product of the two spatially separated leakage streams. Evaluated against three real ANSSI ASCAD datasets (ATmega8515 masked AES-128 and 50/100-sample desynchronized variants), the framework achieves a simulated key rank of 18 +/- 1.7 (five-seed) at 0.25 m on the primary masked dataset. Profiling-trace cross-correlation alignment reduces single-drone rank from 89 to 21 on the 100-sample-jitter variant, demonstrating compensation for drone hover vibration. A two-channel CNN in the Accumulator converges to a loss of 0.454 (vs. random baseline 5.545) and improves rank on desynchronized datasets. No physical hardware has been fabricated; prototype construction is the planned next step.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 TriSweep 的四无人机（四旋翼）集群框架，用于对嵌入式微控制器进行电磁侧信道分析（EM-SCA）。传统 EM-SCA 假设探针静止且紧贴芯片，低估了空中威胁。TriSweep 通过仿真评估了在0.25-1.5米距离内，利用四架无人机协同完成旁路攻击的可行性。体系结构包括：三架专用采集无人机——Anchor（全频谱采集）、Mask Probe（掩码寄存器加载泄漏采集）和 Cipher Probe（掩码 SubBytes 输出泄漏采集），以及一架地面固定式汇聚无人机（Accumulator），负责相干合并（实现+4.8 dB信噪比增益）并通过两个空间分离泄漏流的中心乘积实现二阶掩码抵消。在三个真实 ANSSI ASCAD 数据集（ATmega8515 掩码 AES-128 及50/100样本去同步变体）上测试，主掩码数据集在0.25米距离下的模拟密钥秩达到18±1.7（五种子）。使用跟踪-迹互相关对齐可将单无人机在100样本抖动变体上的密钥秩从89降至21，补偿了无人机悬停振动。汇聚无人机上的双通道 CNN 损失收敛至0.454（随机基线为5.545），并改善了去同步数据集上的密钥秩。目前未制造物理硬件，原型构建为下一步计划。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次提出多无人机集群实现远程电磁侧信道攻击的仿真框架，扩展了传统侧信道攻击的威胁模型，对嵌入式安全评估和物理安全防护具有前瞻意义。

items.title: UNAD+: An Explainable Hybrid Framework for Unknown Network Attack Detection
items.summary: The detection of previously unseen network attacks remains a major challenge for intrusion detection systems. Although supervised learning methods often perform well on known attack classes, they are limited when new attack types are not represented in the training data. Unsupervised methods are more suitable for detecting zero-day attacks, as they do not require labelled attack samples, but they often suffer from high false positive rates, which limits their real-world usefulness. This paper presents UNAD+, an enhanced framework for unknown network attack detection derived from the previously proposed Unknown Network Attack Detector (UNAD). UNAD+ combines a benign-only unsupervised ensemble with Weighted Majority Voting (WMV), a supervised refinement stage trained on pseudo-labelled detections, and a post hoc explainability layer that provides both local and global explanations. The framework was evaluated on the CICIDS2017 and NSL-KDD benchmark datasets. The results show that UNAD+ improves on the original UNAD framework, achieving F1-scores above 98% across the benchmark datasets while significantly reducing false positives and enhancing transparency and deployment suitability through integrated explainability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对网络入侵检测中未知攻击（零日攻击）检测的挑战，提出了一种名为 UNAD+ 的增强型混合框架。研究背景指出，监督学习方法在已知攻击类别上表现良好，但无法检测训练数据中未出现的攻击类型；无监督方法虽然无需标记攻击样本，但往往假阳性率高，限制实际应用。UNAD+ 框架基于先前提出的 Unknown Network Attack Detector (UNAD) 进行改进，其核心方法包括：1）仅使用良性数据训练的无监督集成模型，结合加权多数投票 (WMV) 进行初始检测；2）引入监督精炼阶段，利用伪标记的检测结果训练分类器，以降低假阳性；3）集成事后可解释性层，提供局部和全局解释，增强透明度和部署实用性。实验在 CICIDS2017 和 NSL-KDD 基准数据集上进行，结果表明 UNAD+ 相比原始 UNAD 框架，F1 分数超过 98%，同时显著降低假阳性率，并通过可解释性提升了模型的可用性。本文适合网络安全研究人员、入侵检测系统开发者及安全运维人员阅读，以了解如何结合无监督与监督方法并引入可解释性来提升零日攻击检测能力。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: UNAD+ 提供了一种实用的零日攻击检测方案，通过混合框架在保持高检测率的同时大幅降低假阳性，并集成可解释性，有助于安全团队在实际网络环境中部署并理解检测结果，增强对未知威胁的响应能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该框架可直接应用于企业网络入侵检测系统，提升对未知攻击的识别效果，并适用于需要高准确率和低误报的安全运营场景，如金融、政府等关键基础设施网络防护。

items.title: Innovations in Cardless Artificial Intelligence Banking: A Comprehensive Framework for Cyber Secure and Fraud Mitigation using Machine Learning Algorithms
items.summary: The advent of cardless artificial intelligence (AI) banking heralds a paradigm shift in the financial landscape, offering users unprecedented security and convenience. This paper outlines a comprehensive framework designed to enhance cybersecurity, introduce auto-generated virtual cards, and mitigate fraud risks within cardless AI banking systems. The framework envisions a future banking architecture that employs AI-powered data cryptography to create secure virtual cards for seamless transactions. By emphasizing secure communication channels, it ensures the integrity of financial activities among banking systems, cardholders, and third-party vendors. AI-based authorization methodologies play a pivotal role in authenticating each transaction while proactively identifying potential fraud, demonstrating the framework's efficacy in fortifying cardless AI banking security. The initial approach, featuring an AI-driven, feature-based banking system, ensures the generation of virtual cards with encrypted data, minimizing information exposure and reducing fraud risks. Integrating a machine learning algorithm adds an additional layer of protection against potential fraudulent activities. In conclusion, the proposed framework establishes a holistic cybersecurity and fraud-mitigation paradigm for cardless AI banking systems. Its implementation empowers financial institutions to address security concerns associated with traditional banking, paving the way for a future banking landscape that is not only fraud-resistant but also secure and convenient for users.
